rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the mango fruit.

example.english: I bought some mango fruit to take home.
example.traditional: 我買咗幾個芒果返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gei2 go3 mong1 gwo2 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this specifically when referring to the mango tree rather than its fruit.

example.english: That mango tree bears fruit every year.
example.traditional: 嗰棵芒果樹年年都結果。
example.jyutping: go2 fo2 mong1 gwo2 syu6 nin4 nin4 dou1 git3 gwo2
